category_title: Older adolescents with severe CHARGE syndrome and challenging behaviors
minimal_context: David is sitting at a table in the school for mealtime and is presented with his lunch.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time for lunch. Here is your food.

STUDENT: (Refuses to eat, turning his head away from the food.)

TUTOR: Come on, you need to eat your lunch.

STUDENT: (Continues refusing to eat, pushing the food away.)

TUTOR: Try to take at least one bite.

STUDENT: (Exhibits disruptive behavior by throwing his food.)

options.A: Teach appropriate social and communication skills to the student during mealtimes.
options.B: Combine photo elicitation with life-story splicing of narrative inquiry during mealtimes.
options.C: Show a short film about his sensory loss and communication, followed by a Q&A session.
options.D: Play the music of W. A. Mozart for the student during mealtimes.
